McMahon, O'Connor Davies LLP, 500 Mamaroneck Ave., Harrison, NY 10528 (the "Transferor") and 548 W 22 HOLDING LLC, with an address at c/o Property Markets Group, 5 East 17th Street, New York, New York 10003 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 699, Lot 27 as shown on the Tax Map of New York, Borough of Manhattan (the “Tax Map"), and as more particularly described in Exhibit I attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Granting Site"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 693, Lot 59 as shown on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Receiving Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is a “granting site" as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, part of the Receiving Parcel is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98- 33 of the Zoning Resolution, as more particularly described in Exhibit Ml (hereinafter the "Receiving Site"); and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,” as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, allowable for the development of the Granting Site is unused and is available for transfer under Section 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the New York City Department of City Planning ("DCP'") of their intent to transfer six thousand two hundred fourteen and three hundred thirty- five thousandths (6,214.335) square feet of floor area from the Granting Site to the Receiving Site (the “Receiving Site Rights"); and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 98-60 of the Zoning Resolution an Access Easement Volume Agreement establishing a primary access easement on Block 699 was recorded in the Office of the City Register for New York County on August 4, 2014, at CRFN #2014000255149; and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Receiving Site Rights to the Receiving Site. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows:

1. Transferor hereby grants, transfers, distributes and sets over the Receiving Site Rights from the Granting Site to the Receiving Site solely for the use and benefit in perpetuity of the Receiving Site (and not for the use or benefit of any other lot or parcel of land). 2.7 The Transferor covenants that, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law, it will receive any consideration paid for such rights as a trust fund and will apply the same first to payment of the cost of improvements before using any part of the same for any other purposes.  3.  Transferee covenants that from and after the date hereof it shall not apply for nor seek or cause the issuance of a building permit by the New York City Department of Buildings (the "DoB") for any enlargement or development on the Receiving Site that would involve use of the Receiving Site Rights until (i) it has provided to the DCP certified copies of (a) a Notice of Zoning Lot Restrictions and (b) a Restrictive Declaration, in forms satisfactory to the DCP, as recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York for the County of New York, and (ii) notice by the DCP of its receipt of such copies has been given to the DOB. 4. This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights has been executed and delivered by Transferor without any representations, warranty or recourse of any kind. 5.This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights shall be recorded by Transferor against the Granting Site and Receiving Parcel in the Office of the Register of City of New York, New York County and a copy provided to the DCP in accordance with the provisions of Section 98-33(a) of the Zoning Resolution. 6.  Transferor covenants to execute and deliver from time to time, upon request by, and at the expense of the Transferee or successor in interest to the Transferee, and at no cost to Transferor, such instruments as are necessary to confirm that the property interest hereby transferred consists solely of the Receiving Site Rights and does not include fee ownership of land or other ownership interests which would subject the Receiving Site, or any successor in interest to the Transferee's interest therein, to liability for real estate taxes, water and sewer charges, or other similar governmental or public utility charges applicable to the Granting Site.  7. This instrument may be executed in counterparts, all of which, when taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. [SignaturePageFollows]
